summary: The order socket refuses the session with MO1001 (Invalid User Id Or Auth Token): no order update on either side, and the desktop stops the order feed instead of retrying a dead session.

sources: broker/motilal/streaming/motilal_order_adapter.py:29 (doc 34: MO1001 Invalid User Id Or Auth Token)
notes: Desktop decision (lead, 2026-11-09): MO1001 means the session is not valid (doc 34, motilal_order_adapter.py _WS_ERROR_CODES), so the desktop ends the order feed through its auth-failure path (FeedEvent::AuthFailed) instead of keeping a socket that can carry no order update; no frame differs from the web.
